slides.title: Q4 Strategic Review
slides.speaker_note: Welcome everyone to the Q4 review. We'll cover key metrics and strategic recommendations.

slides.title: Key Insights

insights: Customer retention improved to 94%, up from 89%
New product line accounts for 18% of total revenue
Operational costs decreased by 12% through automation
Market share increased in 3 out of 4 key segments

slides.speaker_note: These five insights form the foundation of our success this quarter.

slides.title: Revenue Growth Trajectory
slides.speaker_note: Notice the consistent growth pattern, with Q4 2025 showing the strongest performance.

slides.title: Market Share Distribution
slides.speaker_note: Product A continues to dominate with 35% market share.

slides.title: Opportunities & Challenges

right_column.heading: Challenges
items: Talent acquisition in key technical roles

slides.speaker_note: Balancing opportunities with realistic risk assessment is critical for 2026 planning.

slides.title: Strategic Recommendations

content.recommendation: Accelerate European expansion while consolidating North American market leadership
rationale: European market projected to grow 40% over next 3 years
Strong brand recognition already established in UK and Germany
Regulatory environment favorable for our product category
next_steps: Establish European headquarters in Amsterdam by Q2 2026
Localize product offerings for EU compliance

slides.speaker_note: This recommendation requires board approval and a budget allocation of €2.5M.

slides.title: Methodology & Data Sources

items: Market share: Gartner Industry Report Q4 2025
Growth projections: Internal forecasting model v3.2

slides.speaker_note: All data has been verified by the finance team and external auditors.
